_about: Approval ledger for Mulank content. An entry lets content into a PRODUCTION report only if its status is `verified` (external expert: reviewed_by + reviewed_on) or `owner_approved` (editor + approved_by + approved_on, all named people and a date). sample_ok / needs_review / pending never count. Text lives in mulank_bank.json; a pair is sold only when every key it needs is approved AND has text. Change this file only through a reviewed PR.
